person_note: The novel sustains two base persons in major sections: an anonymous third-person limited narrator presents Ruth's contemporary story, while LuLing's substantial manuscript narrates her own past in first person. The authorized excerpts independently demonstrate each person, and the Oxford Academic study explicitly confirms the whole-book two-perspective structure. The Goodreads material agrees through third-person Ruth passages (especially q00603 and q00609) and the constitutive first-person memoir passage q00613. First-person dialogue and generic aphoristic 'I,' 'we,' or 'you' were treated as local or nondiagnostic. No credible contrary structural evidence remains.
